mcq.QUESTION_DESC: Why are carry look-ahead adders (CLA) preferred over ripple-carry adders for large bit sizes?

sq.ANSWER: • A Carry Look-Ahead Adder (CLA) computes all carry outputs in parallel using Generate (G = A·B) and Propagate (P = A ⊕ B) signals, avoiding sequential carry propagation and thus reducing delay.
